note: The textual foundation (al-nuṣūṣ): the Qurʾān and the Sunna, on which every term's ruling, qāʿida and farq of the bank rests. Āyāt are quoted from the pinned muṣḥaf (tanzil-quran-simple) at their sūra and āya; marfūʿ ḥadīth from the pinned primary collections at their number, each with al-Albānī's verdict from al-Irwāʾ, and admitted only through the ḥujja gate (decision D4, `Usul.Seam.admitted`). An athar is recorded as an athar, with al-Albānī's word on it, and never stands as a marfūʿ naṣṣ.

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَإِن كُنتُمْ جُنُبًا فَاطَّهَّرُوا
ayat.en: «and if you are junub (in janāba), purify yourselves» (fa-ṭṭahharū: ṭahāra from the major ḥadath): ghusl

ayat.excerpt_ar: فَاغْسِلُوا وُجُوهَكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ إِلَى الْمَرَافِقِ
ayat.en: «wash (ighsilū: ghasl) your faces and your hands to the elbows»: the ghasl of limbs in wuḍūʾ

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَلَا جُنُبًا إِلَّا عَابِرِي سَبِيلٍ حَتَّىٰ تَغْتَسِلُوا
ayat.en: «nor junub, except passing through, until you have washed (ghusl)»

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَأَتِمُّوا الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمْرَةَ لِلَّهِ
ayat.en: «complete the ḥajj and the ʿumra for God»: once in iḥrām, completion is due (F12)

ayat.excerpt_ar: فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ فِي الْحَجِّ
ayat.en: «whoever finds no sacrifice: a fast of three days in the ḥajj» (F11: «لأن الله عين الثلاثة أن تكون في الحج»)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَمَن قَتَلَهُ مِنكُم مُّتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَاءٌ مِّثْلُ مَا قَتَلَ مِنَ النَّعَمِ
ayat.en: «whoever of you kills it deliberately, the jazāʾ is the like of what he killed, from the livestock» (F15 quotes it; F17: «لظاهر النص»)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَلَكُمْ فِي الْقِصَاصِ حَيَاةٌ
ayat.en: «in qiṣāṣ there is life for you» (F49 quotes it)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا اللَّهَ عُرْضَةً لِّأَيْمَانِكُمْ
ayat.en: «do not make God, by your oaths (aymān), a barrier» (F63 quotes it)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً طَهُورًا
ayat.en: «and We sent down from the sky water ṭahūr»

ayat.excerpt_ar: فَكَفَّارَتُهُ إِطْعَامُ عَشَرَةِ مَسَاكِينَ
ayat.en: the kaffāra of an oath (yamīn): «its expiation is feeding ten poor»

ayat.excerpt_ar: فَفِدْيَةٌ مِّن صِيَامٍ أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ نُسُكٍ
ayat.en: the muḥrim's fidya: «a fidya of fasting, charity (ṣadaqa) or a sacrifice»

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَدِيَةٌ مُّسَلَّمَةٌ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ
ayat.en: the diya of killing by error: «and a diya handed to his family»

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ يُطِيقُونَهُ فِدْيَةٌ طَعَامُ مِسْكِينٍ
ayat.en: «and on those who can bear it with hardship, a fidya: feeding a poor man»

ayat.excerpt_ar: فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا مَاءً فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا
ayat.en: «and you find no water (māʾ), then make tayammum with clean earth (ṣaʿīd)»: al-Mughnī reads «ماء» as indefinite after a negation («نكرة في سياق النفي»), so general for every water

ayat.excerpt_ar: فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا مَاءً فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا
ayat.en: «and you find no water (māʾ), then make tayammum with clean earth (ṣaʿīd)»: tayammum only for one who does not find water (al-Mughnī: «فاشترط أن لا يجد الماء»)

ayat.excerpt_ar: إِذَا قُمْتُمْ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ فَاغْسِلُوا وُجُوهَكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ إِلَى الْمَرَافِقِ وَامْسَحُوا بِرُءُوسِكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُمْ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ
ayat.en: the āya of wuḍūʾ: «when you rise to prayer, wash (ighsilū: ghasl) your faces and your hands to the elbows, wipe (masḥ) your heads, and your feet to the ankles»; it names no tasmiya («فلم يذكرها», al-Mubdiʿ)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَطَعَامُ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ حِلٌّ لَّكُمْ
ayat.en: «the food of those given the Book is lawful (ḥill) for you»: al-Mughnī, after Ibn ʿAqīl, from it that their vessels are not ḥarām («لا يحرم استعمال أوانيهم»)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَلَا تُبْطِلُوا أَعْمَالَكُمْ
ayat.en: «and do not render your deeds void» (ibṭāl: «ولا تبطلوا»)

ayat.excerpt_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْإِحْسَانِ وَإِيتَاءِ ذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَيَنْهَىٰ عَنِ الْفَحْشَاءِ وَالْمُنكَرِ وَالْبَغْيِ
ayat.en: «God commands justice (al-ʿadl) and excellence (al-iḥsān) … and forbids indecency, wrong and oppression»: al-Saʿdī Q1 (every command is maṣlaḥa)

ayat.excerpt_ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ رَبِّيَ الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ
ayat.en: «say: my Lord has forbidden only the indecencies (al-fawāḥish)»: the prohibitions (al-Saʿdī Q1)

ayat.excerpt_ar: قُلْ فِيهِمَا إِثْمٌ كَبِيرٌ وَمَنَافِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَإِثْمُهُمَا أَكْبَرُ مِن نَّفْعِهِمَا
ayat.en: wine and gambling (al-maysir): «in them is great sin and benefits for people, and their sin is greater than their benefit» (al-Saʿdī Q1)

ayat.excerpt_ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ لَا يُصِيبُهُمْ ظَمَأٌ وَلَا نَصَبٌ وَلَا مَخْمَصَةٌ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
ayat.en: «that is because no thirst, fatigue or hunger strikes them in the path of God …»: the means of an act of worship count with it (al-Saʿdī Q2)

ayat.excerpt_ar: يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ بِكُمُ الْيُسْرَ وَلَا يُرِيدُ بِكُمُ الْعُسْرَ
ayat.en: «God wants ease (al-yusr) for you, and does not want hardship for you» (al-Saʿdī Q3)

ayat.excerpt_ar: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
ayat.en: «God does not burden a soul beyond its capacity (wusʿahā)» (al-Saʿdī Q3)

ayat.excerpt_ar: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَا آتَاهَا
ayat.en: «God does not burden a soul except with what He has given it» (al-Saʿdī Q3)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍ
ayat.en: «and He has not placed on you any constraint (ḥaraj) in religion» (al-Saʿdī Q3)

ayat.excerpt_ar: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ
ayat.en: «so fear God as far as you are able (mā istaṭaʿtum)» (al-Saʿdī Q3, Q4)

ayat.excerpt_ar: فَمَنِ اضْطُرَّ فِي مَخْمَصَةٍ غَيْرَ مُتَجَانِفٍ لِّإِثْمٍ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
ayat.en: «whoever is compelled by hunger (iḍṭurra fī makhmaṣa), not inclining to sin, God is forgiving»: necessity (ḍarūra) lifts the prohibition (al-Saʿdī Q4)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَقَدْ فَصَّلَ لَكُم مَّا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِلَّا مَا اضْطُرِرْتُمْ إِلَيْهِ
ayat.en: «He has detailed for you what He has forbidden you, except what you are compelled to (mā uḍṭurirtum ilayhi)» (al-Saʿdī Q4)

ayat.excerpt_ar: لَّيْسَ عَلَى الْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلَا عَلَى الْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌ
ayat.en: «there is no constraint (ḥaraj) on the blind, the lame or the sick»: no wājib beyond capacity (al-Saʿdī Q4)

ayat.excerpt_ar: أَلَا لِلَّهِ الدِّينُ الْخَالِصُ
ayat.en: «indeed, to God belongs the sincere religion (al-dīn al-khāliṣ)»: ikhlāṣ (al-Saʿdī Q5)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَمَا أُمِرُوا إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ
ayat.en: «they were commanded only to worship God, making the religion sincerely His (mukhliṣīna lahu al-dīn)» (al-Saʿdī Q5)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَمَا آتَاكُمُ الرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ وَمَا نَهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ فَانتَهُوا
ayat.en: «whatever the Messenger gives you, take it, and whatever he forbids you, refrain»: mutābaʿa (al-Saʿdī Q5)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ دِينًا مِّمَّنْ أَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌ
ayat.en: «who is better in religion than one who submits his face to God while being a muḥsin»: both foundations together (al-Saʿdī Q5)

ayat.excerpt_ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ شَرَعُوا لَهُم مِّنَ الدِّينِ مَا لَمْ يَأْذَن بِهِ اللَّهُ
ayat.en: «or have they partners who legislated for them in religion what God did not permit?»: no worship without the Lawgiver (al-Saʿdī Q6)

ayat.excerpt_ar: هُوَ الَّذِي خَلَقَ لَكُم مَّا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا
ayat.en: «it is He who created for you all that is on the earth»: the default in customs is permission (al-Saʿdī Q6)

ayat.excerpt_ar: قُلْ مَنْ حَرَّمَ زِينَةَ اللَّهِ الَّتِي أَخْرَجَ لِعِبَادِهِ وَالطَّيِّبَاتِ مِنَ الرِّزْقِ
ayat.en: «say: who has forbidden the adornment of God which He brought forth for His servants, and the good things of provision?» (al-Saʿdī Q6)

ayat.excerpt_ar: فَإِنْ آنَسْتُم مِّنْهُمْ رُشْدًا فَادْفَعُوا إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَالَهُمْ
ayat.en: «if you perceive in them right judgement (rushd), hand over to them their property»: rushd a sharṭ of financial dealings (al-Saʿdī Q7)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَعَاشِرُوهُنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ
ayat.en: «and live with them in kindness (bi-l-maʿrūf)»: the measure referred to custom (ʿurf) (al-Saʿdī Q9)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَلَهُنَّ مِثْلُ الَّذِي عَلَيْهِنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ
ayat.en: «and they have rights like those upon them, according to what is recognised (bi-l-maʿrūf)» (Ibn ʿUthaymīn on al-ʿurf)

ayat.excerpt_ar: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَأْكُلُوا أَمْوَالَكُم بَيْنَكُم بِالْبَاطِلِ
ayat.en: «do not consume one another's property unjustly (bi-l-bāṭil)» (Ibn ʿUthaymīn: «والدليل على هذه القاعدة», liability for itlāf)

ayat.excerpt_ar: مَا عَلَى الْمُحْسِنِينَ مِن سَبِيلٍ
ayat.en: «there is no way (sabīl) against those who do good (al-muḥsinīn)»: the trustee is not liable (Ibn ʿUthaymīn)

ayat.excerpt_ar: إِنَّمَا السَّبِيلُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ يَظْلِمُونَ النَّاسَ
ayat.en: «the way (al-sabīl) is only against those who wrong people»: the wrongdoer is liable (Ibn ʿUthaymīn)

ayat.excerpt_ar: فَلَا عُدْوَانَ إِلَّا عَلَى الظَّالِمِينَ
ayat.en: «there is no aggression except against the wrongdoers (al-ẓālimīn)» (Ibn ʿUthaymīn)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَأَقْسِطُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِينَ
ayat.en: «and be just (aqsiṭū): God loves the just» (al-Saʿdī Q16)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَإِنْ عَاقَبْتُمْ فَعَاقِبُوا بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبْتُم بِهِ وَلَئِن صَبَرْتُمْ لَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لِّلصَّابِرِينَ
ayat.en: «if you retaliate, retaliate with the like of what you were dealt; but if you are patient, it is better for the patient»: ʿadl and faḍl (al-Saʿdī Q16)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَجَزَاءُ سَيِّئَةٍ سَيِّئَةٌ مِّثْلُهَا فَمَنْ عَفَا وَأَصْلَحَ فَأَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ
ayat.en: «the recompense of an evil is an evil like it; but whoever pardons and makes peace, his reward is with God»: ʿadl permitted, faḍl urged (al-Saʿdī Q16)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَلَا تَنسَوُا الْفَضْلَ بَيْنَكُمْ
ayat.en: «and do not forget generosity (al-faḍl) between you» (al-Saʿdī Q16)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَمْرًا أَن يَكُونَ لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ
ayat.en: «it is not for a believing man or woman, when God and His Messenger have decided a matter, to have a choice in their matter» (al-Saʿdī Q17)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَيَوْمَ يُعْرَضُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا عَلَى النَّارِ أَذْهَبْتُمْ طَيِّبَاتِكُمْ فِي حَيَاتِكُمُ الدُّنْيَا وَاسْتَمْتَعْتُم بِهَا
ayat.en: «the day the disbelievers are exposed to the Fire: you exhausted your good things in your worldly life and enjoyed them» (al-Saʿdī Q17)

ayat.excerpt_ar: فَمَنِ اعْتَدَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَاعْتَدُوا عَلَيْهِ بِمِثْلِ مَا اعْتَدَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ
ayat.en: «whoever transgresses against you, transgress against him with the like (bi-mithli) of what he did»: the like is made good by its like (Ibn ʿUthaymīn)

ayat.excerpt_ar: إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ الشَّيْطَانُ أَن يُوقِعَ بَيْنَكُمُ الْعَدَاوَةَ وَالْبَغْضَاءَ فِي الْخَمْرِ وَالْمَيْسِرِ وَيَصُدَّكُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ وَعَنِ الصَّلَاةِ
ayat.en: «Satan only wants to cast enmity and hatred among you through wine and gambling (al-maysir), and to turn you from the remembrance of God and from prayer» (al-Saʿdī Q21)

ayat.excerpt_ar: إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَامَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ
ayat.en: «when they cast their pens, which of them would take charge of Maryam»: the lot (qurʿa) (Ibn ʿUthaymīn)

ayat.excerpt_ar: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُدْحَضِينَ
ayat.en: «and he cast lots (fa-sāhama) and was among the losers»: the lot (qurʿa) (Ibn ʿUthaymīn)

ayat.excerpt_ar: فَإِن لَّمْ تَكُونُوا دَخَلْتُم بِهِنَّ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ
ayat.en: «but if you have not gone in to them, there is no sin on you»: the qualifier «اللاتي دخلتم بهن» excludes, stated explicitly (Ibn ʿUthaymīn)

ayat.excerpt_ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا الْقُرْآنَ يَهْدِي لِلَّتِي هِيَ أَقْوَمُ
ayat.en: «this Qurʾān guides to that which is most upright» (al-Saʿdī Q33: aqwam, «أصلح وأحسن»)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَاتَّبِعُوا أَحْسَنَ مَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم
ayat.en: «and follow the best of what has been sent down to you from your Lord» (al-Saʿdī Q33)

ayat.excerpt_ar: أَمَّا السَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتْ لِمَسَاكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِي الْبَحْرِ فَأَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَاءَهُم مَّلِكٌ يَأْخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصْبًا
ayat.en: al-Khiḍr damages the ship lest a king seize it outright: the lighter of two harms (al-Saʿdī Q33)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَأَمَّا الْغُلَامُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ فَخَشِينَا أَن يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَانًا وَكُفْرًا
ayat.en: al-Khiḍr and the boy who would have burdened his believing parents with transgression and disbelief (al-Saʿdī Q33)

ayat.excerpt_ar: فَاسْتَبِقُوا الْخَيْرَاتِ
ayat.en: «so race to all that is good» (Ibn ʿUthaymīn: the dalīl for preferring the higher maṣlaḥa)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَلَا تَسُبُّوا الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ فَيَسُبُّوا اللَّهَ عَدْوًا بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ
ayat.en: «do not revile those they call on besides God, lest they revile God in enmity without knowledge» (Ibn ʿUthaymīn: the lighter mafsada is borne)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا مَالَ الْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ
ayat.en: «do not approach the orphan's property except in the best way» (al-Saʿdī Q34: the guardian chooses what is best for his ward)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى فَاعْتَزِلُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي الْمَحِيضِ
ayat.en: «they ask you about menstruation: say, it is a harm (adhā), so keep away from women during menstruation» (al-Saʿdī Q58: the ruling follows its ʿilla)

ayat.excerpt_ar: وَيُحِلُّ لَهُمُ الطَّيِّبَاتِ وَيُحَرِّمُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْخَبَائِثَ
ayat.en: «he makes lawful for them the good things and forbids them the foul» (al-Saʿdī Q58: ḥill turns on al-ṭayyib, taḥrīm on al-khabath)

ahadith.matn_ar: يغسل ذكره ويتوضأ
ahadith.en: al-madhy: he washes (ghasl) his private part and makes wuḍūʾ

sources.numbering: Muḥammad Fuʾād ʿAbd al-Bāqī (Shamela 1727)

ahadith.matn_ar: إذا رأيت المذي فاغسل ذكرك، وتوضأ وضوءك للصلاة، فإذا فضخت الماء فاغتسل
ahadith.en: al-madhy: wash and wuḍūʾ; al-manī (faḍkh al-māʾ): ghusl

ahadith.en: al-manī rubbed off the garment and prayed in: ṭāhir

ahadith.en: the herders' concession to stone on later days (F16)

sources.numbering: Muḥyī al-Dīn ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd (Shamela 1726); not al-Albānī's Ṣaḥīḥ Abī Dāwūd numbering

ahadith.en: the ḥajj of a child below discernment (F73: «كما دل عليه النص»)

sources.numbering: Muḥammad Fuʾād ʿAbd al-Bāqī (Shamela 1727)

ahadith.matn_ar: من أحيا أرضا ميتة فهي له، وليس لعرق ظالم حق
ahadith.en: «a wrongdoer's root has no right» (F148 quotes it)

ahadith.matn_ar: إن الله قد أعطى كل ذي حق حقه فلا وصية لوارث

ahadith.en: breaking an oath (yamīn) for what is better, with kaffāra (F63 quotes its sense)

sources.numbering: Muḥammad Fuʾād ʿAbd al-Bāqī (Shamela 1727)

ahadith.matn_ar: الشفعة كحل العقال

sources.numbering: Muḥammad Fuʾād ʿAbd al-Bāqī (Shamela 1198)

ahadith.en: the ḥadīth against the fasting man's siwāk after midday (F20: «ولم يصح حديث يدل على الفرق»); in none of the pinned collections

ahadith.matn_ar: هو الطهور ماؤه الحل ميتته
ahadith.en: the sea: «its water is ṭahūr, its dead lawful»

ahadith.en: whoever vows (nadhr) to obey God, let him obey Him (al-Saʿdī Q47; F61)

ahadith.en: «no wuḍūʾ for one who does not mention the name of God over it»: the tasmiya of wuḍūʾ; its holders read the negation as of the wuḍūʾ itself («نفي في نكرة», al-Mughnī), so wājib

ahadith.en: the Prophet's ghusl from janāba began with a wuḍūʾ as for prayer: his act (fiʿl)

ahadith.en: the vessels of the People of the Book: «if you find others, do not eat in them; if you do not, wash them (ghasl) and eat in them»

ahadith.en: «clean earth (al-ṣaʿīd) is the Muslim's ṭahūr though he find no water for ten years; when he finds water, let him touch his skin with it»

ahadith.en: «whoever forgets a prayer, let him pray it when he remembers it»: an omitted command is not discharged by forgetting (al-Saʿdī Q27)

ʿAbd al-Fattāḥ Abū Ghudda (Shamela 829)

ahadith.matn_ar: ما كان من شرط ليس في كتاب الله فهو باطل وإن كان مائة شرط
ahadith.en: any sharṭ (al-sharṭ) not in the Book of God is bāṭil, even a hundred of them (Ibn ʿUthaymīn on al-Saʿdī Q38)

sources.numbering: Fuʾād ʿAbd al-Bāqī, as in Dār Ṭawq al-Najāh (Shamela 1681)

ahadith.matn_ar: أرأيت إن قتلته؟ قال: «هو في النار»
ahadith.en: the man who kills one who assails him for his property: the assailant is in the Fire (Ibn ʿUthaymīn on al-Saʿdī Q36)

sources.numbering: Muḥammad Fuʾād ʿAbd al-Bāqī (Shamela 1727)

ahadith.matn_ar: لعن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في الخمر عشرة: عاصرها ومعتصرها
ahadith.en: the Prophet cursed ten in respect of wine, among them its presser and the one for whom it is pressed (Ibn al-Qayyim on intents in contracts; al-Saʿdī Q51)

sources.numbering: Aḥmad Shākir et al. (Shamela 7895)

ahadith.matn_ar: الولد للفراش وللعاهر الحجر، واحتجبي منه يا سودة
ahadith.en: the child of Zamʿa's slave-woman: the child belongs to the firāsh, and Sawda is to veil from him (Ibn al-Qayyim: rulings divide within one person; al-Saʿdī Q31)

sources.numbering: Fuʾād ʿAbd al-Bāqī, as in Dār Ṭawq al-Najāh (Shamela 1681)
Muḥammad Fuʾād ʿAbd al-Bāqī (Shamela 1727)

albani.numbering: al-Irwāʾ's own entry numbers; entry 2110 is the dispute of Saʿd and ʿAbd b. Zamʿa

athar.excerpt_ar: أما المني فهو الذي منه الغسل وأما المذي والودي فقال: اغسل ذكرك أو مذاكيرك وتوضأ وضوءك للصلاة
athar.en: al-manī: ghusl; al-madhy and al-wadī: wash and wuḍūʾ
athar.albani_ar: هذا موقوف والاستدلال به وحده - مع أنه مختلف في صلاحيته للاحتجاج به

athar.excerpt_ar: وأخرج عبد الرزاق من قول شريح: إنما الشفعة لمن واثبها
athar.en: «pre-emption belongs to whoever jumps at it»: Shurayḥ's saying, not the Prophet's ﷺ (F92 cites it among «الأحاديث التي استدلوا بها»)
athar.albani_ar: وأخرج عبد الرزاق من قول شريح

athar.excerpt_ar: إذا بلغت المرأة خمسين سنة خرجت من حد الحيض
athar.en: «when a woman reaches fifty years she leaves the bound of ḥayḍ»: Aḥmad mentions it and al-Mughnī gives it for the fifty riwāya («لما روي عن عائشة»); al-Albānī (al-Irwāʾ 186) did not find it («لم أقف عليه»), so it carries no verdict
athar.albani_ar: لم أقف عليه. ولا أدرى فى أى كتاب ذكره أحمد
